text: ‘Cultural differences between countries are disappearing as a result of globalisation.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
OR
‘Developing countries remain poor due to dependency on rich capitalist countries.’ Evaluate this
view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘Owners of the media have little control over media content.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Media representations of women no longer reflect gender stereotypes.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘The role of religion is to prevent conflict in society.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘All societies are experiencing a decline in religiosity.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
